subject: U-442 test adequacy NO-GO: five Required findings
body: Reviewed a5f84978548a00a97cfcc11614aa6bdfd71683e6 with independent scratch-clone mutants, checked the vacuity guard, and wrote the authorized uncommitted report. All 1714 head tests and validation pass, but four behavioral mutants survive the 255 covering tests and same-path artifact collisions expose wrong-root acceptance at untouched head, yielding five Required findings and a NO-GO verdict. The implementation owner must fix the collision behavior and add regression coverage for all five findings before re-review.
